description: R-LINK-1 fixture: native file A with local control table L (a copy of SRC's schema and rows) and two persistent links created by CreateTableDef(name, attributes, SourceTableName, Connect) and TableDefs.Append: LK to SRC in src (';DATABASE=inputs\r-enc-link-src.accdb'), and LKP to SRC in the password-protected srcpwd with the password in Connect and Attributes dbAttachSavePWD. Connect, SourceTableName, Attributes, fields, indexes and rows are read after each Append. Image kept.
